Name: CJB Show Item Sell Price
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: See the sell price of items in your inventory.
Description:
See the sell price of items in your inventory:
![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods/master/CJBShowItemSellPrice/docs/screenshot.gif)

**Translated into Chinese, English, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish ([translations welcome](https://github.com/CJBok/SDV-Mods#translating-the-mods)).**

## Install
1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).
2.  Install the mod through ModDrop (or unzip the mod folder into `Stardew Valley/Mods`).
3.  Run the game using SMAPI.

## Compatibility
*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows.
*   Works in single-player and multiplayer.
*   No known mod conflicts.
